explication: PMG is a command-line package-install firewall: developers and coding agents keep using familiar package-manager commands, while PMG intercepts installs, checks threats and cooldown policy, optionally sandboxes execution, and records an audit trail. The per-command flow is the runtime orchestrator; a persistent proxy daemon supports intercepted traffic across ecosystems. The graph preserves documented protections and operational capabilities. Some subsystems are represented from README and index references because their implementation excerpts were not provided.
